common_intent_requirements.text: 把用细绳挂着的小球拉到一侧后静止松开
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把用细绳挂着的小球拉到一侧后静止松开
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a small ball suspended from a thin string attached to a fixed support. Include the attachment point, the complete string, and the space for the ball to swing. A hand pulls the ball to one side and holds it motionless, then opens and moves out of its path.

common_intent_requirements.text: 让它在固定支点下左右来回摆动
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 让它在固定支点下左右来回摆动
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Continue several natural left-right swings along the arc defined by the string. The support remains fixed, and the string stays connected to the same ball throughout.

physics_checks.criterion: 球的运动受绳长和固定支点约束，释放后摆向低处并经过下方区域来回运动。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 可追踪球、绳和固定支点，绳球连接在往返过程中保持。
fail_examples: 球离开绳端独自直线飞行
绳长任意大幅变化使球沿直线往返
没有新推动时摆幅持续明显增大
not_required: 不要求片尾静止或完全二维运动

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
